little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she went to the park with her mommy. They played on the swings and the slide, but then Lily saw a big dog. She was scared and started to cry.
Her mommy hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. The dog is friendly. He just wants to play." Lily felt better and stopped crying. She looked at the dog and saw that he was wagging his tail. She petted him and said, "Hi, doggy
